machine: Apple M1 Max, 32 GB unified memory

method.scheduler: Pinned FlowMatchEulerDiscreteScheduler with dynamic exponential shift and terminal sigma 0.02
method.reference: Pinned official Diffusers BF16 transformer on MPS; FP32 Euler update cast back to BF16 after every step
method.native: FP32 activations and outputs; custom FP16 SIMD-group GEMM for the 278-row prefix and cached attention projections; directly mapped FP16 MLP weights or dynamic Q8-to-FP16 conversion feeding MPSMatrixMultiplication; 32-lane SIMD-group attention; and identical per-step BF16 latent rounding
method.cache: Step 1 extracts post-RoPE prefix K and raw V; steps 2-40 execute target rows only from the same 32-layer cache

interpretation: The final 1.00775% latent nRMSE is accumulated complete-runtime divergence from official BF16 execution, not a quantization-only number. MPS preserves FP32 outputs but, like the accepted custom kernels, consumes FP16 operands. Exact production-shape probes selected a hybrid: custom Metal remains faster for BF16 square attention projections, while MPS wins on both MLP shapes and all measured Q8 shapes. QIPACK v2 stores the 88 non-Q8 MLP matrices directly as FP16, which is the exact operand representation previously produced dynamically from the BF16 source. Direct mapped binding eliminates their repeated conversion without a second 9.7 GB runtime copy, reducing summed GPU time from 37778.1 ms to 33092.1 ms (12.4%) while every checkpoint nRMSE remains identical.
limitations: The 1-step and 2-step commands validate prefixes of the official 40-step schedule; they are not separate one-step or two-step schedules.
The trajectory is 256px so a 40-step regression remains practical. The earlier independent scale gate covers 512px and 1024px single-step execution.

Summed GPU time excludes packed-file validation, pipeline compilation, CPU scheduler work, and process startup; each transformer block is batched into one command buffer containing ordered custom-Metal and MPS encoders.
Prompt embeddings and initial noise are precomputed fixtures. Native prompt encoding and RNG remain later boundaries.
No VAE decode is included; this gate ends at the latent after scheduler step 40.
